name: Doodle Ipsum · Doodle Ipsum

title.zh: Doodle Ipsum · 选风格定尺寸生成涂鸦占位图拿

description.zh: 生成器已显示固定图片URL与一张具体人物插画；不宣称已操作复制。 Doodle Ipsum 是 Blush 推出的单页插画占位图工具，提供 Random、Flat、手绘等风格，可按尺寸、分类与背景等参数生成可嵌入的图片链接。插画使用遵循 Blush 许可，允许用于商业与非商业最终产品，禁止转售原图或做周边。
description.en: Doodle Ipsum is a single-page illustration placeholder tool from Blush with styles such as Random, Flat, hand-drawn and avatars, generating embeddable image URLs by size, category and background parameters. Illustration use follows the Blush license, allowing commercial and non-commercial end products while prohibiting resale of the artwork or merchandising.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Doodle Ipsum (https://doodleipsum.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 生成器已显示固定图片URL与一张具体人物插画；不宣称已操作复制。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页左栏的风格、比例、宽高与背景，右边是已渲染的人物插画。下方的尺寸与固定图示例，解释如何用网址参数取得占位图；回到生成器，链接区域已显示具体图片地址。适合给原型或落地页快速放上风格统一的插画，之后再换正式内容。使用时按 Blush 许可区分最终作品与原图再分发，别把素材直接转售或做周边。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
